en.headline: Chris Tang and Shenzhen officials inspect new Huanggang Port preparations
en.dek: The Security Bureau chief said both sides agreed the port could open once systems are fully equipped and cross-boundary stress tests are completed successfully.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang and a Shenzhen delegation inspected the Hong Kong side of the redeveloped Huanggang Port on Wednesday to review final preparations for opening.

Tang co-chaired a meeting of the task force on cooperation in the planning and development of Hong Kong-Shenzhen boundary control points with Shenzhen vice mayor Luo Huanghao. In a social-media post he said both sides agreed the port could begin operations once inspection facilities had been fully optimised and cross-boundary stress tests completed successfully.

He described the new Huanggang Port as a major infrastructure project that carries a national mission, and said the authorities aimed to bring it into service as soon as possible while ensuring safe, efficient and smooth operations.

The meeting also reviewed progress on the redevelopment of the Sha Tau Kok Control Point. Earlier large-scale drills involving thousands of personnel have tested crowd management, transport coordination and other operational arrangements at the new facility.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強與深圳官員視察新皇崗口岸準備工作
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示雙方同意在檢測設施完善及跨境壓力測試順利完成後，可盡早啟用新口岸。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周三與深圳代表團視察新皇崗口岸港方口岸區，檢視啟用前的最後準備工作。
鄧炳強與深圳市副市長羅黃昊共同主持港深口岸規劃發展合作專責小組會議。他在社交平台表示，雙方同意在檢測設施全面優化及跨境壓力測試順利完成後，即可啟用口岸。
他指新皇崗口岸不但是重大基建項目，更肩負國家使命，當局目標是在確保安全、高效及暢順運作的前提下，盡早投入服務。
會議亦檢視了沙頭角管制站重建進展。當局早前已進行多次大型演練，測試人流管理、交通協調及其他運作安排。
